Simple Analogy:
Like having a dedicated fast-food worker just for making food, while another handles payments. Specialization = speed!

div.b:
Technical:
vLLM server runs optimized inference (PagedAttention, continuous batching) while training process handles weight updates. Decoupling eliminates the generation bottleneck.

div.b:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like using a delivery service instead of walking to get groceries. The delivery is 10x faster because they have optimized routes and vehicles!
TECHNICAL: vLLM uses PagedAttention for efficient KV-cache memory management and continuous batching to maximize GPU utilization. This allows generation throughput of 4000+ tokens/sec vs 400 tokens/sec with standard inference.
